stemMd: Which EU institution checks the proper collection and use of EU funds?
explanationMd: The European Court of Auditors scrutinises EU financial management. Its institutional name refers to auditing, not a general judicial court deciding all legal disputes. This distinguishes financial accountability from monetary policy.

distractorRationale.d: Monetary policy is distinct from external financial audit.
distractorRationale.a: It is a political leadership body.
distractorRationale.b: It is not the EU's external auditor.
distractorRationale.e: Judicial interpretation differs from regular external audit.
